checks.name: example: General Session opens with 5 presets, 3 destinations, 2 AUX outputs
save / load: the show is identical after a save and a reload
undo / redo: a layer change undoes and redoes
Simple: one preset tile per preset and layer chips on the canvas
Simple: Add Preset adds one, Delete removes it
Simple: copy a preset and paste it onto another
Simple: Add Destination opens its window, adds the destination, and it can be removed
Simple: Duplicate destination carries the clip settings (fit, In / Out, speed, level, look) and is one undo step
Simple: Add AUX adds an output that is on in every preset, Remove takes it away
Simple: an AUX can be switched off for one preset only
Simple: the layer panel lists Position, Size, Opacity, Mask, Border, Shadow, Effects
Simple: the layer panel title reads in full and no caption in the panel is cut off
Simple: typing a Width in the layer panel resizes the layer and the height follows the lock
Simple: a masked layer can sit past the edge by the masked amount, and a Size edit leaves its position alone
Simple: Delete and Backspace never remove a selected destination, a selected layer still goes and comes back with one undo
Simple: a click on a destination that is half out of view does not move the canvas, and click then double-click opens Destination Properties
Simple: a click outside closes the Destination, Layer and AUX panels (another destination, the same destination, the toolbar), a click inside keeps them open
new layer: starts as a centred PIP at half the destination (plain = half by half, a locked picture keeps its shape), also in a slot a removed layer left behind
mask: each side goes to 99 %, opposite sides never pass 99 % together (typed and pasted), one undo per edit, and the Look Book prints it
Simple: an Area of Interest can be switched on and off for a destination
Simple: an active Area of Interest has an Off button on the destination, and Off is one undo step

Simple: Destination Properties Apply is one undo step, Undo brings back size, position and rotation together and nothing older (the Apply lands 40 px on the neighbour: refused with no undo step while Blend Zones is off, accepted through "Add to blend" with it on)
Simple: Destination Properties copies and pastes Size, Position and Rotation between destinations and presets, resets them, shows the aspect ratio
Simple: the EDID note is kept per destination per preset, survives save and load, follows a destination copy and goes with a deleted destination
Simple: a preset name with a quote is kept whole after a redraw, a preset field edit is one undo step, and a code edit leaves the name field alone
Simple: a destination corner drag, an AOI drag, an AOI corner drag, a typed AOI field and a layer corner drag are each one undo step
Simple: a layer drag undoes to where the layer was, dragging a selected chip does not open the Layer panel, and arrow nudges are one undo step
Simple: in the Simple layer panel a Width + Enter, Fill, a library pick, Remove from this preset and the library × are each one undo step
Simple: Show Labels / Remove Labels is one undo step, and a click on the mode already lit changes nothing
Simple: Add AUX (+), the AUX panel Apply and Remove AUX Globally are each one undo step
Simple: a dragged table row or preset tile lands where the drop line shows, a drop on the near half changes nothing, and Undo puts the order back
Simple: a BG colour picked on the first preset shows on the canvas even when the destination carries a BG content colour
Simple: Escape closes the colour picker and leaves the Layer panel under it open; Escape in a table cell cancels the edit
Simple: a table note or P# edit is one undo step, a per-preset destination name shows on that preset's canvas, and the blend window shows all four digits of a resolution
Pixel-Feet: the default is 16 PPI (1 foot = 192 px), a stored 96 PPI is kept, Reset returns to 16 / 192, and Help says 192
Dead Space: a 576 px gap reads 3.00 FT, and 2 typed in FT makes the gap 384 px in one undo step

Dead Space: a gap too narrow for the one-line read-out stacks FT under PX (centred, inside its box, large-gap mark kept, both boxes still set the gap), a roomy gap keeps one line, and five destinations stay readable
Look Book: a printed dead-space read-out stacks only when its text does not fit the gap, feet follow 192 px per foot, and no number box or large-gap mark is printed

move arrows: on a blended pair the ◀ sits on the far left of the left member and the ▶ on the far right of the right member, whichever member is picked; no arrow lies over the blend zone, nothing covers a live arrow, and a press still moves the pair one slot in one undo step
move arrows: three blended destinations keep ◀ ▶ on the outer edges from every member (never over either blend zone) and a press moves all three as one block past a fourth destination
move arrows: on the Advanced page a blended pair has the same outer-edge ◀ ▶ at two zoom levels, only ◀ ▶ are drawn, nothing covers the live arrow and a press moves the pair

no overlap rule: a typed X onto the neighbour is BLOCKED by one "Destinations can't overlap" alert while Blend Zones and Free Position are both off (the pair and the preset are named, nothing moves, no undo step, the unsaved marker does not change); it asks "Create Blend Zone?" with Free Position on, with Blend Zones on and with both on; the same on the Advanced page

no overlap rule: an arrow key held down on a destination that has a second row under it raises ONE alert, not a pile: the size goes back, OK changes nothing, no undo step is left, and a second guarded change made while the alert is still up is put back silently
unsaved: the first look at Wire (random cable colours) leaves a clean show clean, and the colours stay in the show for the next save
unsaved: Wire view settings (zoom, tool, folded panes, collapsed side panel) never light Save and are still written to the show file
unsaved: the first look at Wire Advanced (page 1 built from Simple) and its page tabs leave the show clean, and so does Undo back past it
unsaved: I/O Patch Advanced (first look: page 1 built from Simple), its page tabs and the way back to Simple leave the show clean
unsaved: after the first looks a real edit still lights Save inside a second, looking again never clears it, and Undo returns to clean
unsaved: a real change made in the very same tick as a first look is never hidden, whichever comes first

unsaved: a Look Book with a wire sheet (Advanced, then Simple) and the Wire export window leave a clean show clean

unsaved 2: a show WITHOUT a multiviewer (the launch state of older builds) stays clean when I/O Patch puts MV 1 back

unsaved 2: a destination renamed and saved stays clean when I/O Patch Advanced is looked at, and the old name does not come back as an I/O-only destination

unsaved 2: opening the Backup window (it pairs "X A" / "X B" rows by itself) leaves a saved show clean, and a pair set by hand still lights Save
unsaved 2: an older show whose clip lacks its codec info is opened: the info is filled in a moment later and Save stays clean
unsaved 2: visiting everything (every tool, view, page tab and window) on all three examples stays clean, as shipped and with GFX A / GFX B / PBP A / PBP B saved into them

move arrows: a blended destination that is REMOVED FROM THIS PRESET and picked from its table row still shows the live ▶ on the outer edge of its partner, nothing covers it, and a press moves the pair

unsaved 3: a show with no I/O Patch Advanced block (older files, launch, New): edit + Undo is the saved show again, a first look at I/O Patch Advanced + Undo too; fresh, copied and normalised pages have ONE shape

unsaved 3: an edit made while Save is still writing (file picker, the write takes 300 ms and 1000 ms) is NOT in the file, so Save stays gold and New warns; with no edit during the write Save ends clean, also when Wire is first looked at during the write

unsaved 3: clicking into an AUX cell or an empty layer cell of the Video Presets table and leaving it writes nothing (no AUX content object, no layer object, no undo step, Save clean); typing in the same cells still is one undo step each

unsaved 3: I/O Patch: clicking into a custom Type field and leaving it writes nothing and records no undo step (a file that never "remembered" its custom types); a typed type name still lights Save, is remembered and is one undo step

unsaved 3: Wire, Project Info: clicking into Venue (and every other box) and leaving it writes nothing: a blank venue stays blank and Save stays clean; a typed venue lights Save, and deleting it again is the saved show
unsaved 3: click into EVERY visible field of every page and leave it, nothing typed (an older-style show, then the three examples): Save stays clean and no undo step is recorded
bottom bar: the Advanced page, Wire and I/O Patch end at the top of the bar, and every bar item stays on top
bottom bar: Help opens above each page from the bar, and Escape closes only Help
bottom bar: Bug starts the bug report from each page, and the skin menu opens upward, fully on screen and clickable
bottom bar: the Presets number follows + Preset while the Advanced page is open, and the number is on screen

Wire exports: with the floating I/O Tools button on screen, the Wire sheet and the Look Book wire sheet do not carry it
I/O Patch: the page ends at the bar, the last row scrolls clear of it, and its drop-down stays inside the window
Wire Advanced: Fit, and the automatic Fit after every I/O Tools drop, keep the tiles clear of the floating I/O Tools button
Wire Advanced: I/O Tools stays in the middle of the visible drawing when a side pane folds, the view switches or Wire is reopened
top bar: Wire, I/O Patch and the Advanced page start right under the toolbar again after the toolbar changes height
Help, Modifiers section: the menu is on the preset only (the sentence about a status-bar copy is gone)

Escape in a live box of the Layer panel (Opacity, Mask, Width with the lock on): the show goes back exactly, the boxes next to it follow, no undo step, the panel stays open

Advanced: the first Escape lets go of the picked layer or destination and the page stays, the second goes back to Simple; a menu on top still closes first; Escape in a box keeps the pick

Escape in a box only takes back the TYPING: a corner-handle resize made while the cursor sat in the Width box survives (nothing typed / typed after the drag / typed in another box before the drag), and Undo still undoes that resize

Escape in a box only takes back the TYPING, other pages: the Wire - output button pressed under a typed Project box keeps its change (the old project text is back), and a destination corner drag under the Show name box keeps its size

Advanced: a fader that holds the cursor is not a text box (the first Escape lets go of the layer, the fader value stays); a lit AUX box is a pick (first Escape lets go of it, the second goes back to Simple); the layer strip ghost view ends on the same press as the pick
Reset (preset header): a click opens ONE window "Reset P02 WELCOME?" with Reset All / Destinations / Layers / AUX all ticked, a sentence under each, and changes nothing yet
Reset (preset header): un-ticking a child un-ticks Reset All and only that child, the last child back ticks Reset All, Reset All toggles all three, nothing ticked greys Reset
Reset (preset header): Cancel, Escape and a press outside the window leave the preset alone and record no undo step

Reset (preset header): Reset AUX alone puts only that group back to the Quick Setup state, other presets untouched, one undo step that undoes and redoes

Reset (preset header): a show built by Quick Setup: dirty P02, Reset All, and P02 is again exactly the preset Quick Setup built (save and reload keeps it)
Reset (preset header): nothing to reset for what is ticked greys Reset, says so and records no undo step; ticking a group with work to do makes it live
Reset (preset header): keys: Tab stays inside the window (the picked layer behind it does not change), Shift+Tab goes back, Enter = Reset, Enter on Cancel = Cancel

Dialog is modal (any confirm, any alert): the same page keys do nothing behind a confirm and behind an alert, and Tab stays inside the window instead of stepping to the next layer
Dialog is modal (its own keys still work): Escape cancels, Enter confirms, Tab and Shift+Tab walk Cancel and the main button of a plain confirm, and nothing is held back once the window is closed
Dialog is modal (a HELD Enter never answers): Enter held down on the focused amber Reset opens the window and its auto-repeats do not answer it; a fresh Enter then resets, in one undo step

Reset (preset header): a double-click on Reset leaves the window open: the 2nd (and 3rd) click of the gesture that opened it is not for the window, whether it lands on the dimmed page or on the window's Reset button; a new click outside still cancels at once and a double-click inside the window is two clicks

Reset (preset header) on the FIRST preset: the window promises only what a per-preset reset does: a rotation / name given on P01 stays (show-wide), the sentences and the "Nothing to reset" note say so, and P02 names what stays too

Reset (preset header): Reset AUX on the FIRST preset keeps its AUX / DSM type map (a show from an older build: I/O Patch reads it show-wide), still clears P01's own AUX content in one undo step, and on P02 the type override is cleared as before
Layer strip: every preset header has BG and one box per layer column between Notes and Actions, grey and inert until a destination of that preset is picked

Layer strip: double-click on BG opens Destination Properties, double-click on a layer opens its layer panel, and the ghost stays while the panel is open

Layer strip: a layer under a full-screen layer is picked from the strip and can be dragged on the canvas; the layers above go 15 % click-through, their Level is untouched, the ghost follows a lower pick
Layer strip: the ghost ends on another destination, on empty canvas, on a cleared selection, on Escape and when the page is left
Layer strip: the ghost is never in the show file, the undo data, the Look Book or the Excel sheet, and a save + reload starts without it
Layer strip: an empty box opens the layer panel of that layer (what its table cell opens) and a pick from the list fills it
Layer strip: the bottom-left label of a destination names the top-most displayed layer before the unchanged resolution, on the canvas and in the Look Book
Layer strip: reduced motion swaps the pulse for a steady outline, and the phone build gets today's empty spacer instead of the strip

Layer strip (Advanced page): the tile has the strip, BG picks a covered destination, a covered layer is picked with Properties on Layers, the Display output keeps the real look, leaving the page ends the ghost

Layer strip fix (Advanced page): the tile header gives the strip room (Notes gives way first): BG and the first layer boxes are fully visible and on top, the header stays one line, the row and the Actions group are where they were

Layer strip fix: with the ghost on, a double-click on the destination (through the 15 % layers) opens Destination Properties, never a layer panel, and the ghost stays (Simple and Advanced); one click still lets go

Layer strip fix: the pulse follows the box the user is working on: an empty box clicked while another layer is picked pulses while its content list is open, and the pulse goes back when the list closes
Layer strip fix: Reset Layers in the Reset window while the ghost is on ends the ghost cleanly (BG ghost and layer ghost): nothing stays faded and a layer added right after comes up solid
undo: an action that changes nothing leaves no undo step and leaves Undo dim (Reset Preset Layout with nothing to reset, a preset pasted onto itself)
undo: a press never does nothing: an empty step on top is skipped, the same step is never stacked twice, and Undo / Redo are lit only when a press will do something
undo: a click that ends up changing nothing gives Redo back (Undo, then Reset Preset Layout with nothing to reset: Redo stays lit and still works); a real change still clears Redo
undo: ONE list of view keys: every key in it is left out of the undo snapshot AND of the unsaved comparison; the print sheet size is left out of Undo only
Reset window: a Space HELD from before the window opened (auto-repeat) never answers it, and its key-up reaches the page; a Space first pressed on the window still works

Reset window: the second click of a double-click on the amber Reset is dropped and the focus stays on the window's Reset button; the "nothing to reset" note sits OUTSIDE the scrolling tick block, next to the buttons
undo: a folded preset that is deleted comes back FOLDED after Undo, and a preset folded after + Preset comes back folded after Undo / Redo

layer strip: inside the hold after letting go of a ghosted destination, a FRESH click (click count 1) on a still-faded layer picks that layer, and a slow double-click (click count 2 after 700 ms) still keeps the ghost and lands on the destination

unsaved 4: a write still running when another show is opened never re-baselines the new show; typing "NA" into a blank Venue box is a real edit

toolbar: the Canvas W / H boxes are a read-out in their 16ks boxes: read-only, out of the Tab order, the Show name box's field look, no pointer, tooltip "Calculated from the destinations", and they still follow the destinations
draft: Restore draft brings every destination position back exactly as the draft holds it (a 200 px blend and a free-placed destination), and the restored show is clean with an empty Undo history
draft: a restored, never-saved draft is protected: Open a file, the picker, New, Cmd/Ctrl+N and an example show ask with true wording and keep the draft; after a Save none asks about a draft
toolbar: a press on the Canvas read-out lets go of the picked layer and destination, so Backspace and the arrow keys after it change nothing

Edit Show Info: Cancel, Escape and an unchanged Update Show change nothing, leave no undo step and do not light Save; a show name, date and venue typed in the window reach the top bar and light Save; on an empty show the pencil opens plain Quick Setup

Edit Show Info: the "Show name needed" note takes Enter (it closes and the cursor goes back to the Show name box, it does not come straight back)

Layer panel: the "Remove from ALL presets" window says Undo brings it back, and it does — one Undo puts the layer back in every preset, Redo takes it out again

Layer panel: the two Remove keys share one row, so the Simple panel still fits a 1440x800 laptop window without scrolling and neither key is cut short

Top bar: the Edit Show Info pencil sits at the right end of the SHOW label row (26 x 26, its right edge on the name box's right edge, its bottom clear of the box, level with the label); the label row, the name box and the group height stay as they were, the SHOW group is no wider than the name box, a press on the pencil's own point opens Edit Show Info, and Tab reaches the pencil before the name box
